query.name: recipe-list
query.sql: SELECT recipe.id AS id, recipe.name AS name, recipe.status AS status, node.name AS node_name, recipe.branch_id AS branch_id, COALESCE(branch.name, '') AS branch_name, COALESCE(branch.tag, '') AS branch_tag, COALESCE(branch.status, 0) AS branch_status, COALESCE(MAX(build_ok.number), 0) AS last_build, COALESCE(MAX(build_ko.number), 0) AS failed_build, COALESCE(MAX(build_ok.build_duration), 0) AS max_duration, COALESCE(SUM(build_ok.build_duration), 0) AS sum_duration, COALESCE(MAX(build_ok.pass_count), 0) AS pass_count, COALESCE(SUM(build_ok.pass_count), 0) AS sum_pass, COALESCE(MAX(build_ok.fail_count), 0) AS fail_count, COALESCE(SUM(build_ok.fail_count), 0) AS sum_fail, COUNT(distinct build_ok.id) AS ok_count, COUNT(distinct build_ko.id) AS ko_count FROM porion_recipe AS recipe INNER JOIN porion_branch AS branch ON recipe.branch_id = branch.id INNER JOIN porion_node AS node ON recipe.node_id = node.id LEFT JOIN porion_build AS build_ok ON recipe.id = build_ok.recipe_id AND build_ok.status = 2 LEFT JOIN porion_build AS build_ko ON recipe.id = build_ko.recipe_id AND build_ko.status != 2 WHERE recipe.project_id = :project_id GROUP BY recipe.id, recipe.branch_id
query.sql-count: SELECT count(recipe.id) FROM porion_recipe AS recipe WHERE recipe.project_id = :project_id
